description:
You are the 2nd Assistant Director for the film 'The Midnight Echo'. It is Day 14 of production. You need to create the Daily Call Sheet for tomorrow's shoot using Apache OpenOffice Writer. 

1. Read the production logistics from '/home/ga/Documents/production_data.json'. This file contains the Shooting Schedule, Cast Call Times, Crew Call Times, and Location info.
2. Open Apache OpenOffice Writer and create a new one-page document.
3. Insert the production logo found at '/home/ga/Documents/production_logo.png' at the top.
4. Create a header with the Film Title, 'Day 14 of 24', and the General Crew Call time.
5. Create a 'Shooting Schedule' TABLE listing the scenes (Scene #, Description, Day/Night, Pages, Cast IDs).
6. Create a 'Cast' TABLE listing Character, Actor, Pickup Time, H/M (Hair/Makeup) Time, and Set Call Time. These times must match the JSON exactly.
7. Include the Weather forecast and nearest Hospital info at the bottom.
8. Save the document as '/home/ga/Documents/Call_Sheet_Day_14.odt'.

The document must use proper tables for the schedule and cast sections to be professional.
